title: Protecting Confidentiality, Privacy and Integrity in Collaborative Learning
abstract: arXiv:2412.08534v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: A collaboration between dataset owners and model owners is needed for effective machine learning (ML) training. During this collaboration, however, dataset owners and model owners want to protect the confidentiality of their respective assets (i.e., datasets, models and training code), with the dataset owners also caring about the privacy of individual users whose data is in the datasets. Existing solutions provide limited confidentiality for models and training code, suffer from data privacy issues, or incur unacceptable performance. translated_title: 保护协作学习中的机密性、隐私与完整性
translated_abstract: 有效的机器学习（ML）训练需要数据集所有者与模型所有者之间的协作。然而，在这种协作过程中，数据集所有者和模型所有者都希望保护各自资产（即数据集、模型和训练代码）的机密性，同时数据集所有者还关心数据集中个体用户数据的隐私。现有的解决方案要么对模型和训练代码提供的机密性保护有限，要么存在数据隐私问题，要么会带来不可接受的性能开销。我们提出了Citadel++，一个协作式机器学习训练系统，能够同时保护数据集、模型和训练代码的机密性以及个体用户数据的隐私。具体而言，Citadel++采用了一种链式方法：首先，我们采用虚拟机级别的可信执行环境（TEE）作为训练运行时，为数据集、模型和训练代码提供机密性保护。
tldr: 本文提出Citadel++协作式机器学习训练系统，通过以虚拟机级可信执行环境（TEE）作为训练运行时的链式方法，同时保护数据集、模型和训练代码的机密性以及个体用户数据的隐私。
en_tdlr: Citadel++ is a collaborative ML training system that simultaneously protects the confidentiality of datasets, models, and training code as well as the privacy of individual user data by adopting a chained approach that employs Virtual Machine-level Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) as the training runtime.
